title: Little White House
geometryBasis: Franklin D. Roosevelt’s one-storey cottage, four-column portico, attached rear rooms and curved west deck at Warm Springs, Georgia, as preserved in 2016–17.
sectionBasis: OpenStreetMap way 324614887 fixes the principal mass, east porch and curved deck. The two cleared Qualla photographs set the facade and terrace profile. Deck supports and rear roof geometry are estimated. The independent slope remains unchanged.
limitations: The October 2016 photograph sets the white clapboard front, four columns, black-green shutters, roof and chimney. The March 2017 photograph sets the sun deck rail and dark-green fabric awning.
The main outline, porch extent and deck arc come from the named mapped house. Roof pitches, supports below the sun deck, concealed rear openings, and exact foundation and sill heights are estimates.
The separate guest cottage, servants’ cottage and museum are outside the dwelling model. The original local elevations are unchanged.
